en.description:
Retro arcade games, made for your wrist.

Watch Retro Games puts a pocket arcade on your Apple Watch: shooters, puzzles, board games, sports and split-second timing games, all in bright pixel art. Every game is built around the watch's own controls, so you play with one hand, in a minute or two: on the bus, in a queue, between sets.

PLAY THE WAY YOUR WATCH WORKS
- Turn the Digital Crown to steer, aim and slide
- Tap to jump, fire and drop
- Swipe to hop, shoot and dodge
- Hold, then let go at just the right moment

A FEW OF THE GAMES
- Space Rocks: blast rocks that split into smaller, faster pieces
- Falling Blocks: slide, turn and drop pieces to clear full rows
- Highway Hop: hop a bunny across traffic and ride logs over the river
- Penalty Kick: shoot, then dive to save, and beat five rivals to win the cup
- Reversi: take on a computer rival that levels up every time you win
- Rocket Landing: touch the lander down softly before the fuel runs out
- Cookie Thief: sneak bites of a cookie while the cook's back is turned

…and 25 more, from Ping Pong to Pyramid Hop.

BUILT FOR THE WATCH
- Quick plays of a minute or two
- Your best score saved for every game
- Retro sound effects and haptics on your wrist
- Plays on your watch on its own: no iPhone or internet needed
- Fits every Apple Watch size and supports larger text sizes
- No ads, no in-app purchases

IPHONE COMPANION
Browse all games on your iPhone and watch an animated preview of each one before you play it on your wrist.
en.releaseNotes: • Several bug fixes and performance improvements.
